name: alethia
description: Patent-pending zero-IPC E2E test runtime for AI agents. Run plain-English browser tests at ~13ms/step, enforce the VITRON-EA1 fail-closed safety gate, audit WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and NIST SP 800-53 security controls, and export cryptographically signed evidence packs — all local-only, zero telemetry.

tools.name: alethia_tell
tools.description: Execute plain-English browser test instructions with the EA1 safety gate active.

tools.name: alethia_compile
tools.description: Compile NLP instructions to Action IR without executing them.

tools.name: alethia_status
tools.description: Health probe — runtime version, kill switch state, driver stats.

tools.name: alethia_activate_kill_switch
tools.description: Immediately halt all automation and block subsequent test calls.

tools.name: alethia_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the current page.

tools.name: alethia_eval
tools.description: Evaluate a JS expression in the page under test.

tools.name: alethia_audit_wcag
tools.description: Run a WCAG 2.1 AA audit on the current page.

tools.name: alethia_audit_nist
tools.description: Run a NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security controls audit on the current page.

tools.name: alethia_export_session
tools.description: Export a SHA-256 signed evidence pack of the full session.

tools.name: alethia_tell_parallel
tools.description: Run multiple test flows concurrently against different URLs.

tools.name: alethia_serve_demo
tools.description: Start a local HTTP server for the built-in demo pages.

tools.name: alethia_propose_tests
tools.description: Scan a page and generate a candidate NLP test suite.

tools.name: alethia_assert_safety
tools.description: Prove the VITRON-EA1 policy gate blocks every destructive action on a page.

tools.name: alethia_hide_cockpit
tools.description: Hide the cockpit window (runtime keeps running).
